observations: Seed-Prover 1.5 training evidence strengthens the claim that terminal verifier reward can implicitly reduce tool-call and sequence cost while performance improves, but does not isolate a compact controller.
Public anetigone/cssc independently exposes a closely matched cost-sensitive Lean meta-action space but deliberately begins with heuristic control and no learned value model.

Leanstral 1.5 official open model/SafeVerify surfaces are reproducible enough to consider as a fixed low-level substrate; a third-party evaluation-trace artifact is useful descriptively but lacks proven OPE propensities/legal masks.
Targeted search did not find a primary/public separate compact heterogeneous formal-proof controller trained by RL/bandit/value/offline RL with fixed or clearly factored low-level proof execution.
exact_next_action: Inspect anetigone/cssc controller/state/trace interfaces and roadmap for exact action identity, cost vector, legal-mask representation, branch/effect lifecycle, external-benchmark evidence and any learned-policy path; then map the third-party Leanstral evaluation schema to structural state/action/outcome/cost fields and enumerate missing propensity/legal-mask fields before continuing the targeted compact-controller search.
